entries.rationale: Fully specified fields/schema; directly mirrors the existing ProjectCreate/ProjectRead + projects table pattern already in the repo.
BEH-1 through BEH-5 and all error-case rows fully specified; router pattern (error envelope, IntegrityError catch) is an exact mirror of app/routers/projects.py::create_project.
BEH-6/7/8 fully specified; list/get-by-id pattern is a direct mirror of the existing Project/Issue routers.
BEH-9 fully specified as an independent emptiness check; mirrors fixture-seeding's seed_if_empty pattern closely, deliberately kept as a separate function per charter's additive-directory framing.
Real-HTTP e2e coverage directly mirrors the existing test_project_crud_e2e.py/test_error_paths_e2e.py/test_openapi_and_seed_e2e.py patterns; no new fixture infrastructure needed.
